entries.title: Jeremiah 15:1
segments: ¶Then said the LORD unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, [yet] my mind [could] not [be] toward this people: cast [them] out of my sight, and let them go forth.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:2
segments: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the LORD; Such as [are] for death, to death; and such as [are] for the sword, to the sword; and such as [are] for the famine, to the famine; and such as [are] for the captivity, to the captivity.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:3
segments: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the LORD: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy. {kinds: Heb. families}

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:4
segments: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for [that] which he did in Jerusalem. {cause...: Heb. give them for a removing}

words.text: . {cause...: Heb. give them for a removing}

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:5
segments: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest? {how...: Heb. of thy peace?}

words.text: thee? or who shall go aside

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:6
segments: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the LORD, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:7
segments: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave [them] of children, I will destroy my people, [since] they return not from their ways. {children: or, whatsoever is dear}

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:8
segments: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused [him] to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city. {the mother...: or, the mother city a young man spoiling, etc, or, the mother and the young men}

words.text: . {the mother...: or, the mother city a young man spoiling, etc, or, the mother and the young men}

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:9
segments: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while [it was] yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:10
segments: ¶Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; [yet] every one of them doth curse me.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:11
segments: The LORD said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee [well] in the time of evil and in the time of affliction. {cause...: or, intreat the enemy for thee}

words.text: . {cause...: or, intreat the enemy for thee}

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:12
segments: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:13
segments: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and [that] for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:14
segments: And I will make [thee] to pass with thine enemies into a land [which] thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in mine anger, [which] shall burn upon you.

words.text: And I will make [thee] to pass

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:15
segments: ¶O LORD, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.

words.text: that for thy sake I have suffered

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:16
segments: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts. {I am...: Heb. thy name is called upon me}

words.text: . {I am...: Heb. thy name is called upon me}

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:17
segments: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:18
segments: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, [which] refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar, [and as] waters [that] fail? {fail: Heb. be not sure?}

words.text: ? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:19
segments: Therefore thus saith the LORD, If thou return, then will I bring thee again, [and] thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:20
segments: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I [am] with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 15:21
segments: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.
